text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired pd-embeddings-5xx (severity: high) in eu-prod - 5xx spike on embeddings-queue. auto-escalate -> oncall-sre. links: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
Alice Nguyen: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs now.
Ben Park: oncall rotation note: I'm secondary if you need handoff.
Alice Nguyen: quick triage: HTTP 503s from embed-worker pods in eu cluster, high retry rate, client timeouts starting ~23:34 UTC. Customer impact looks like some embeddings requests failing.
Carol Martinez: Support FYI — which customers hit? I'm pulling support logs and will post summary.
Dave Lee: flagged autoscaler thrashing maybe? seeing repeated scale ups/downs in the last 6m for eu-embed-pool.
Alice Nguyen: confirmed, links from k8s: ```
kubectl get hpa -n infra eu-embed-pool -o yaml
# CPU spike then scale-down loops
```
Alice Nguyen: also seeing OOMKilled on 3/10 worker pods, probably due to a config change pushed ~23:30 (embed mem limits tightened).
Ben Park: if pods OOMing that would cause 503s. Can we temporarily relax mem limit and restart pods?
Alice Nguyen: yep. Plan: 1) patch Deployment mem limits to previous (restore 2Gi) 2) roll restart eu-embed-workers 3) enable burst-capacity (reserve) for embeddings route OR route EU traffic to fallback model embed-lite-v1.
Carol Martinez: Support: I have list of affected customers (IDs obscured): cust-493, cust-112, cust-88 — all on eu region, some saw 503s for batch embedding jobs. I'm sending short incident message to those accounts now.
Dave Lee: I'm applying patch to revert memory limits now — taking small risk on memory vs stability. Patch command: ``kubectl set resources deployment/eu-embed-workers -n infra --limits=memory=2Gi``
incident-bot: Deploybot: patch started by Dave Lee for eu-embed-workers. CI check passed.
Alice Nguyen: restarting pods (kubectl rollout restart). Watching logs.
Ben Park: switching routing: temporarily route to embed-lite-v1 for non-critical calls. Updating router rule: ``/embeddings -> embed-lite-v1 if client.tier != enterprise and region==eu``
Alice Nguyen: seeing decreasing 503s, error rate trending down from 18% -> 4% over last 3m. Latency still elevated but stabilizing.
Carol Martinez: customer notif sent: "We're investigating intermittent embedding failures in EU; mitigation in progress. We'll post updates every 15 minutes." :email:
Dave Lee: pods coming up clean, OOMs stopped. Autoscaler now stable.
Ben Park: I took over the thread (taking ownership from Alice). ping @Alice if you need to hand back.
Alice Nguyen: thanks — handing to Ben for runbook follow-through. I'm staying on watch for another 10m.
Ben Park: ack. next steps: 1) keep embed-lite routing for 15m, 2) monitor error-rate and token success metrics, 3) schedule follow-up to decide whether to revert mem limit change or adjust heap tuning.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation suppressed (ack by Ben Park).
Carol Martinez: Support update: escalated to three enterprise contacts with ETA note. No customer data loss. Impact: transient failures for batch jobs — guidance to retry.
Ben Park: status ping: error-rate 1.2% now, token latency 220ms (was 140ms), cost slightly higher but acceptable.
Dave Lee: I'll open a short postmortem draft and assign owner. Suspect root cause: premature mem limit reduction in config push which caused OOM cascade under burst.
Alice Nguyen: capturing commands and logs in the incident doc: https://confluence.example/incidents/INC12345
Ben Park: handoff note: I'll own postmortem and remediation (tweak HPA cool-down and add a canary check on mem-limit changes).
Carol Martinez: closing customer-facing loop in 30m with final update.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved? (manual close required)
Ben Park: marking as resolved in PagerDuty now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Carol Martinez: leaving note for postmortem — customer impact severity: medium, affected envelopes: ~12 customers with failed batches, no data loss.
Dave Lee: follow-ups: add alert for OOM spike on embed-workers, add automated detection for mem-limit diffs in CI.
Alice Nguyen: thanks team. I'll sign off from active watch.
Ben Park: last check-in: all green in eu-prod for 10m, closing thread. Postmortem owner: Ben Park.
Support Bot: Incident notification: closing customer notifications queue for INC12345.
